summary: Cross-platform system cleaner and security scanner that optimizes performance and detects malware on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
usecases: Clean junk files and free disk space on daily-workstation environments.
Scan for malware and enforce security hardening configurations on developer machines.
Manage startup items and schedule system maintenance for fleet-wide optimization.
ideas: Integrate with enterprise MDM solutions like Intune for remote device hygiene.
Add browser-based system health checks before accessing web applications.
Implement GPU-accelerated threat scanning for large-scale deployments.
